question.text: A USDINR option with premium Rs. 0.25 has intrinsic value of Rs. 0. How much time value does it have?

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 70 of the source states that an option premium consists of intrinsic value and time value, and that time value equals premium minus intrinsic value. With premium Rs. 0.25 and intrinsic Rs. 0, time value = 0.25 - 0 = Rs. 0.25. The Trap: Zero intrinsic value does not mean zero premium — page 70 notes that ATM and OTM options have zero intrinsic value but still carry time value until expiry. Note: Page 71 restates the same identity: premium = intrinsic value + time value.
